_comment: spec-v7 Step 123 — mutation testing. Scoped to the highest-value pure extractors; a separate, slow, on-demand/scheduled job, never the per-push gate. `mutate` and the `include` list in vitest.mutation.config.ts MUST stay in step — a file listed here whose tests are not included there reports 0% with every mutant NoCoverage. tests/integration/mutation-scope.test.ts asserts they agree.
_thresholds_comment: Regression-only (spec-v7 Step 124): break a couple points under the measured baseline; never an aspiration. Runs only in the scheduled/on-demand mutation workflow, not the per-push gate. Ratchet up as survivors are killed. CURRENT baseline 53.94% over dates+amounts+crossrefs+sections (1,433 mutants), 2026-08-17, break 52. NOTE scores are comparable ONLY within one `mutate` set: widening from 2 files to 4 moved the aggregate from 56.16 to 52.34 without anything getting worse, because crossrefs and sections score below the original pair. History: 51.26% baseline (2026-06-05, dates+amounts, break 48); decayed to 47.59 and BROKE the gate as those two files grew without matching tests; covering three then-untested features took the pair to 56.16; scope widened to four files (52.34); pinning each external-citation branch in crossrefs took it to 53.94. CEILING NOTE: crossrefs' ~270 remaining survivors are mostly EQUIVALENT mutants inside long alternations (\s+ -> \s, [A-Za-z]+ -> [A-Za-z], dropped ^ anchors) that no realistic legal drafting distinguishes — 41 new branch-pinning test rows moved it only 42.86 -> 46.80. Further gains need a different lever, not more rows.
